outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care or special care nursery
cohort: 636,227 women who gave birth between 2002 and 2012
finding: Sleep apnea was associated with increased risk of pregnancy hypertension, planned delivery, preterm birth, low 5-minute Apgar score, admission to neonatal intensive care, and large-for-gestational-age infants, but not with gestational diabetes, cesarean section, perinatal death, or small-for-gestational-age infants.
